findings: The long central body and paired hover pods remain substantial from front, side, rear, top, and isometric views.
Front identity includes a layered grille, two separately clustered four-barrel weapons, and ribbed outer pods.
Side identity includes the large bordered rescue door, teal nacelle volume, canopy, and front/rear pod transitions.
Rear identity includes a service panel, red rails, three central drive cores, and layered outer exhaust louvers.
The underside is populated by a broad equipment bay, gimbal, tanks, hover cores, and four support modules.
The white, gray, teal, red, and cyan materials are crisp Minecraft panels without stochastic noise.
The release manifest and deterministic ZIP contain only the five retained native artifacts; the private reference is optional and unbundled.
known_limitations: Minecraft cuboids deliberately simplify the source's continuous bevels and circular turbine ports.
The references do not expose internal underside surfaces, so those remain explicitly inferred.
A separate read-only grader passed the exact implementation commit recorded above.
